allocation: 16-byte aligned first-fit; adjacent free ranges coalesce
compaction: stable source-offset order; in-place downward relocation; one compacted free tail
automaticTrigger: upload cannot fit a contiguous range but total free bytes cover it
explicitTrigger: Profiler > Compact GPU Arenas; queued until an active upload publishes
budget: Destination writes from uploads plus relocation never exceed the viewport upload write budget. Relocation additionally reads the same bytes into at most 64 KiB CPU staging.
drawDuringMove: Completed primitive prefix at destination, remaining suffix at source; indirect and fallback paths use the same ranges
ownership: Freeze allocations/releases during compaction; retire removed chunks until commit. Mid-layout retirement can create new holes after commit; later retries may compact again. Epoch reset discards the entire old layout.
statistics: used/capacity/free/largest-free bytes, uploaded/relocated destination bytes per frame, remaining bytes, completed compactions, queued/active state, retiring chunks
failure: No progress acknowledgement after a failed GL read/write. Existing streaming error handling disables the failed scene and preserves the last framebuffer; no promise of recovery from device loss.
nativeMinimum: Desktop OpenGL 3.0; buffer readback/subdata requires no newer copy-buffer extension
